import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { HttpClient } from '@angular/common/http'; import { BillingRecord } from './models/billing.model'; @Component({ selector: 'app-root', templateUrl: './app.component.html', styleUrls: ['./app.component.css'] }) export class AppComponent implements OnInit { allRecords: BillingRecord[] = []; filteredRecords: BillingRecord[] = []; visibleRecords: BillingRecord[] = []; selectedIds = new Set(); activeTab: BillingRecord['status'] = 'Billing List'; searchTerm = ''; startDate = '2024-04-17'; endDate = '2025-05-16'; page = 1; pageSize = 10; filterOpen = false; constructor(private http: HttpClient) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.http.get('assets/billing-data.json').subscribe(data => { this.allRecords = data; this.applyFilters(); }); } get selectedCount(): number { return this.selectedIds.size; } clearSelection(): void { this.selectedIds = new Set(); } setTab(tab: BillingRecord['status']): void { this.activeTab = tab; this.page = 1; this.applyFilters(); } onSearch(term: string): void { this.searchTerm = term; this.page = 1; this.applyFilters(); } onDateRange(range: { start: string; end: string }): void { this.startDate = range.start; this.endDate = range.end; this.page = 1; this.applyFilters(); } applyFilters(): void { const search = this.searchTerm.toLowerCase(); this.filteredRecords = this.allRecords.filter(row => { const matchesTab = row.status === this.activeTab; const matchesSearch = !search || Object.values(row).some(value => String(value).toLowerCase().includes(search)); const matchesDate = (!this.startDate || row.orderDate >= this.startDate) && (!this.endDate || row.orderDate <= this.endDate); return matchesTab && matchesSearch && matchesDate; }); this.refreshPage(); } refreshPage(): void { const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(this.filteredRecords.length / this.pageSize)); if (this.page > totalPages) this.page = totalPages; const start = (this.page - 1) * this.pageSize; this.visibleRecords = this.filteredRecords.slice(start, start + this.pageSize); } changePage(page: number): void { this.page = page; this.refreshPage(); } changePageSize(size: number): void { this.pageSize = size; this.page = 1; this.refreshPage(); } toggleFilter(): void { this.filterOpen = !this.filterOpen; } download(): void { window.alert('CSV download is ready to be connected to your export API.'); } tableAction(event: { type: string; record: BillingRecord }): void { if (event.type === 'upload-csv') { window.alert(`CSV selected for ${event.record.orderNumber}`); return; } if (event.type === 'delete') { window.alert(`Delete ${event.record.orderNumber}`); return; } window.alert(`${event.type.toUpperCase()} action for ${event.record.orderNumber}`); } }
